## Design update — user-facing macro syntax added

Thanks for the feedback, @Droyd97. I've added a new **Section 2 — User-Facing Macro Syntax** to the design doc ([view on branch](https://github.com/vertexrs-io/vertexrs/blob/feat/14-per-node-failure-mode-syntax/docs/design/0014-per-node-failure-mode-syntax.md)).

### What changed


| Syntax | Failure | `pure` |
|---|---|---|

The section includes:
- Per-sigil prose describing the observable runtime behaviour (what the pipeline returns, what the column contains, what warnings are emitted)
- An example of a node-level sigil overriding a pipeline-level `settings { failure: … }` block

### Trade-offs

- I chose to place the syntax section **before** the Reuse Audit so readers see the contract first and internals second — this is more implementer-friendly.
- The table in §2.7 is a concise all-combinations reference to use as a checklist during implementation.

### Remaining open questions

None — the acceptance criteria, call flow, and generated-code snippets in §§5–6 remain unchanged and are unambiguous.

---

**Ready for human sign-off.** Review the design on the draft PR (https://github.com/vertexrs-io/vertexrs/pull/15) and in this comment, then set the `design-approved` label on this issue to trigger the Implementer, who will pick up the branch and complete the implementation.
